Package com.example.whimsy

Class Mood

java.lang.Object
com.example.whimsy.Mood
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Mood extends Object implements Serializable

Mood Class

The Mood class represents a user's mood by encapsulating detailed mood information such as mood status, location, time, gathering status, mood trigger, reason for the mood, and associated images. This class is designed to be serializable and provides accessor methods for all its attributes.

Usage: Create instances of Mood to store and retrieve mood-related data. The class includes several constructors for different instantiation scenarios.

Outstanding Issues:

  • The overloaded constructor Mood(String, String, String, String, String, String, String, String, String, String, List<String>, boolean) is currently not implemented. It should be either removed or properly implemented.

Note: The Mood class is part of the Project Whimsy and may be subject to further enhancements.

      public Mood(String userName, String userId, String userLocation, String timestamp, String userTime, String userGatheringStatus, String moodStatus, String moodTrigger, String moodReason, String moodImage, String profileImageUrl, List<String> taggedUserNames, boolean isPrivate)
      Constructs a Mood instance with all attributes specified.
      Parameters:
      userName - The name of the user.
      userId - The unique identifier of the user.
      userLocation - The geographical location of the user.
      timestamp - The timestamp when the mood was recorded.
      userTime - The time the mood was recorded.
      userGatheringStatus - The gathering status of the user (e.g., alone, with friends).
      moodStatus - The mood of the user (e.g., happy, sad, angry).
      moodTrigger - The trigger event or circumstance for the mood.
      moodReason - The reason behind the mood.
      moodImage - An optional image representing the mood.
      profileImageUrl - The URL of the user's profile image.
      taggedUserNames - A list of tagged usernames.
      isPrivate - The privacy status of the mood.
